english: Far northwest of the main Hawaiian Islands, open water surrounds remote atolls and reefs. Near the end of the chain lies Kure Atoll, visited by several ships before 1827. Its low coral reef and small islands offered little warning to vessels approaching across the North Pacific.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷主岛群远西北方，开阔水域环绕着偏远环礁和珊瑚礁。岛链末端附近是库雷环礁，1827年以前已有数艘船只到访。低矮的珊瑚礁与小岛难以向横渡北太平洋的船只提供明显警示。

english: The sea north of the northwestern Hawaiian atolls forms part of the open North Pacific. The reefs below are low and widely scattered: Pearl and Hermes Atoll, for example, is mostly submerged. In 1822 its reef wrecked the two British whalers whose names it bears.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷西北环礁以北的海域属于开阔的北太平洋。南面的珊瑚礁低矮而分散，例如珍珠与赫耳墨斯环礁大部分位于水下。1822年，两艘英国捕鲸船在其礁上失事，环礁后来以两船命名。

english: North of Holoikauaua, the North Pacific stretches beyond the low reefs of the Hawaiian chain. The atoll was named Pearl and Hermes after two British whalers that struck its reef on the same night in 1822. Their stranded crews salvaged timber and built a small schooner.
simp_chinese: 霍洛伊考阿瓦阿以北，北太平洋延伸在夏威夷岛链的低矮珊瑚礁之外。1822年，两艘英国捕鲸船同夜在该环礁触礁，环礁后来以两船命名为珍珠与赫耳墨斯。受困船员回收木材，建造了一艘小型纵帆船。

english: The high sea north of the northwestern Hawaiian Islands lies beyond a chain of low islands and submerged reefs. In 1805 the Russian ship Neva grounded near Papaʻāpoho while sailing from Sitka toward Macao. The island and the adjoining shoal were named for the captain and his ship.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷西北列岛北方的远海位于一连串低岛和暗礁之外。1805年，俄国船只“涅瓦”号从锡特卡驶往澳门途中在帕帕阿波霍附近搁浅。该岛和邻近浅滩分别以船长和船只的名字命名。

english: Northeast of Papaʻāpoho, open water extends beyond the scattered reefs of the northwestern Hawaiian chain. The Russian ship Neva grounded near the island in 1805. Its captain Yuri Lisianski freed the ship, giving the island its later European name and the nearby shoal the name of his vessel.
simp_chinese: 帕帕阿波霍东北方，开阔水域延伸至夏威夷西北列岛零散的珊瑚礁之外。1805年，俄国“涅瓦”号在该岛附近搁浅。船长尤里·利相斯基使船脱险；该岛后来的欧洲名称取自船长之名，附近浅滩则以船名命名。

english: Northeast of the low islands of the northwestern Hawaiian chain lies open North Pacific water. The Russian ship Neva encountered the region in 1805, grounding near Papaʻāpoho. Captain Yuri Lisianski freed his ship after jettisoning cargo; the broad shoal nearby came to bear the vessel’s name.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷西北列岛低矮岛屿的东北方是开阔的北太平洋水域。1805年，俄国“涅瓦”号来到这一地区，在帕帕阿波霍附近搁浅。船长尤里·利相斯基抛弃部分货物后使船脱险；附近广阔浅滩后来以船名命名。

english: The open ocean between Mokumanamana and Papaʻāpoho belongs to the northwestern reach of the Hawaiian chain. Hawaiians visited Mokumanamana and left religious structures and carved stone images. Farther northwest, the Russian ship Neva grounded near Papaʻāpoho in 1805 during its voyage across the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 莫库马纳马纳与帕帕阿波霍之间的开阔海域属于夏威夷岛链西北部分。夏威夷人曾到访莫库马纳马纳，留下宗教建筑和雕刻石像。再向西北，俄国“涅瓦”号于1805年横渡太平洋途中在帕帕阿波霍附近搁浅。

english: Southeast of Papaʻāpoho lies a broad expanse of the Pacific, close to the extensive Neva Shoals. In 1805 the Russian vessel Neva ran aground in this region during its voyage from Sitka to Macao. Captain Yuri Lisianski eventually freed the ship from the reef.
simp_chinese: 帕帕阿波霍东南方是一片广阔太平洋，靠近面积巨大的涅瓦浅滩。1805年，俄国船只“涅瓦”号从锡特卡驶往澳门途中在这一地区搁浅。船长尤里·利相斯基最终使船脱离珊瑚礁。

english: South of Papaʻāpoho, the North Pacific surrounds the remote reefs of the northwestern Hawaiian Islands. The Russian ship Neva grounded near the island in 1805, and its captain Yuri Lisianski had to free it from the shallows. A Hawaiian gourd was seen on the beach during the visit.
simp_chinese: 帕帕阿波霍南方，北太平洋环绕着夏威夷西北列岛的偏远珊瑚礁。1805年，俄国“涅瓦”号在岛附近搁浅，船长尤里·利相斯基设法使船脱离浅水。船员到访期间在海滩上看见了一只夏威夷葫芦器皿。

english: Southwest of Holoikauaua, the Pacific stretches around the low reefs of the northwestern Hawaiian chain. In 1822 two British whalers, Pearl and Hermes, were wrecked together on that atoll. Most survivors were eventually taken aboard a passing ship, while others sailed a schooner built from the wreckage to Honolulu.
simp_chinese: 霍洛伊考阿瓦阿西南方，太平洋环绕着夏威夷西北岛链的低矮珊瑚礁。1822年，英国捕鲸船“珍珠”号和“赫耳墨斯”号一同在该环礁失事。大部分幸存者最终由过往船只救走，另一些人乘用残骸建造的纵帆船驶至檀香山。

english: South of Kuaihelani, open Pacific waters lie beyond the reefs of the remote northwestern Hawaiian Islands. The atolls here offered little high ground to warn approaching ships. In 1822 the whalers Pearl and Hermes were both wrecked on Holoikauaua, east of Kuaihelani.
simp_chinese: 库艾赫拉尼以南的开阔太平洋位于夏威夷西北列岛偏远珊瑚礁之外。这里的环礁几乎没有高地，难以警示驶近的船只。1822年，捕鲸船“珍珠”号和“赫耳墨斯”号在库艾赫拉尼以东的霍洛伊考阿瓦阿一同失事。

english: West of the northwestern Hawaiian atolls, the ocean crosses the longitude of the antimeridian. Near the end of the island chain, Kure Atoll has a ring of coral around a lagoon. Several vessels visited it before 1827 and recorded the atoll under different names.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷西北环礁以西，大洋跨越本初子午线的对面经线。岛链末端附近的库雷环礁有一圈珊瑚礁环抱潟湖。1827年以前，数艘船只到访，以不同名称记载了这座环礁。

english: South of the northwestern Hawaiian chain, open water extends toward the central Pacific. The islands to the north include Papaʻāpoho, where the Russian ship Neva grounded in 1805. A Hawaiian gourd seen on the island during that visit pointed to an earlier connection with the Hawaiian world.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷西北岛链以南，开阔水域向中太平洋延伸。北方的岛屿包括帕帕阿波霍，俄国“涅瓦”号于1805年在此附近搁浅。船员到访时在岛上看到的一只夏威夷葫芦器皿，显示这里与夏威夷世界早有联系。

english: At the far northwestern end of the Hawaiian chain, the Pacific surrounds isolated Kure Atoll. Its coral reef encloses a lagoon, while the small Green Island rises above the water. Several ships visited the atoll before 1827, giving it a succession of names.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷岛链最西北端，太平洋环绕着孤立的库雷环礁。珊瑚礁包围一片潟湖，水面上露出一座小小的格林岛。1827年以前，数艘船只到访这座环礁，并先后给它起了不同的名字。

english: Lake Hāwea lies in an inland basin of the southern South Island, backed by high mountains. The Hāwea River carries its waters south towards the Clutha. The lake is one of the great inland waters of a region traversed by Māori, who travelled into the headwaters of nearby lakes in search of prized pounamu.
simp_chinese: 哈韦亚湖位于南岛南部的内陆盆地，背靠高山。哈韦亚河将湖水向南送往克卢萨河。它是当地重要内陆湖泊之一；毛利人穿行于这一地区，前往附近湖泊的上游寻找备受珍视的绿玉。

english: The Hawequas Mountains rise above the valleys of the southwestern Cape. Their name recalls the Indigenous people also known as the Obiqua or Ibequa, who inhabited the region. Sandstone ridges and steep slopes support mountain fynbos, while streams descend towards the Berg River valley. Together with neighbouring ranges, the Hawequas form part of the mountain barrier between the Cape coast and the inland valleys beyond.
simp_chinese: 哈韦夸斯山脉高耸于开普西南部的河谷之上。山名使人想起曾居住在这一地区的原住民，他们也被称为奥比夸或伊贝夸。砂岩山岭和陡坡上生长着山地芬博斯灌丛，溪流向下汇入贝格河谷。哈韦夸斯与邻近山脉一起，构成开普海岸和内陆河谷之间的山地屏障。

sources.title: Heritage Drakenstein Heritage Survey Report October 2012 final.pdf

english: The Hawk Hills rise in the northern forest country west of the Peace River. They form part of the Peace River uplands, a region of wooded heights and river valleys in northwestern Alberta. Nearby ranges include the Naylor Hills to the north and the Clear Hills farther south. The rivers that cut through this country connect the uplands with the broad Peace River valley.
simp_chinese: 鹰丘矗立在皮斯河以西的北方森林地带，属于艾伯塔西北部林地高丘与河谷交错的皮斯河高地。附近的丘陵还有北方的内勒丘和更南方的克利尔丘。河流切穿这片土地，将高地与宽阔的皮斯河谷联系起来。

english: Hawke Bay forms a broad indentation on the east coast of New Zealand’s North Island. Māori communities occupied its coast and the lands around the sheltered Ahuriri lagoon. In October 1769 James Cook sailed into the bay in the Endeavour and named it for the British First Lord of the Admiralty, Edward Hawke.
simp_chinese: 霍克湾是新西兰北岛东岸的一处宽阔海湾。毛利社群居住在其沿岸及避风的阿胡里里潟湖周围。1769年10月，詹姆斯·库克乘奋进号驶入海湾，以英国第一海军大臣爱德华·霍克为其命名。

english: The cold Labrador Current flows south along this coast, carrying ice into waters fringed by islands and shoals. Farther south, the Strait of Belle Isle separates Labrador from Newfoundland. In the sixteenth century Basque whalers crossed the Atlantic to hunt in and around the strait, establishing shore stations where the blubber of right and bowhead whales was rendered into oil for shipment home.
simp_chinese: 寒冷的拉布拉多洋流沿海岸向南流动，将冰带入岛屿和浅滩环绕的水域。更南方的贝尔艾尔海峡将拉布拉多与纽芬兰分开。十六世纪，巴斯克捕鲸人横渡大西洋，在海峡及附近追猎鲸鱼；他们在岸边设立作业站，将露脊鲸与弓头鲸的脂肪熬成鲸油，运回故乡。

english: The ǁHawoben are a Nama community associated with the dry country around Koës in southern Namibia. Their homeland lies between the stony uplands and the sandy Kalahari, where herding depends upon access to grazing and water. Nama communities used kinship and local knowledge to live across these extensive arid lands.
simp_chinese: 哈沃本人是与纳米比亚南部科埃斯一带干旱地区相关的纳马社群。他们的土地位于石质高地和卡拉哈里沙地之间，畜牧依赖牧场和水源。纳马社群凭借亲缘联系与地方知识，在这片广阔的干旱土地上生活。

sources.title: Report of the commission of inquiry into claims of ancestral land rights and restitution.pdf

english: Hawraman is a rugged land of steep valleys in the Zagros. Its Hawrami communities build stone villages in tiers, with roofs forming terraces beneath the houses above. Dry-stone walls support gardens on the slopes. Families combine cultivation with the seasonal movement of flocks, spending colder months in lower valleys and moving in warmer weather to highland dwellings known as havars, near springs and lingering snow. Ancient paths, fortresses and cemeteries bear witness to the long occupation of these mountains.
simp_chinese: 哈乌拉曼是扎格罗斯山脉中河谷陡峭的险峻地区。哈乌拉米社群沿山坡层叠修建石屋，下层房屋的屋顶成为上层的露台，干砌石墙则支撑着坡地园圃。家庭将耕作与季节性放牧结合：寒冷月份住在较低的河谷，天气转暖后便迁往靠近泉水与残雪的高地住所，称为哈瓦尔。古道、堡垒和墓地见证了群山中悠久的居住史。

english:
Buhaya lies west of Lake Victoria, a country of banana gardens and long-established ironworking traditions. Haya farmers grew bananas in household plots known as bibanja, alongside other crops. Coffee too had a place in local life: its beans were prepared with spices and offered to honoured guests, and they featured in ritual as well as exchange.

Haya oral traditions trace the founding of several kingdoms to the sixteenth century, including Kyamtwara and Kiziba. The Bankango clan is associated with the former, and the Bakama with the latter. Their rulers governed neighbouring communities around the western shore of the lake. The Haya country remained linked to other Great Lakes kingdoms by ties of trade and political allegiance; coffee was among the goods valued beyond its gardens.

The later city of Bukoba lies here.
simp_chinese:
布哈亚位于维多利亚湖西岸，是一片香蕉园地和冶铁传统悠久的地区。哈亚人在称为比班贾的家庭园地里种植香蕉和其他作物。咖啡豆也在地方生活中占有一席之地：人们用香料烹制后赠给尊贵的客人，也将其用于仪式和交换。

哈亚人的口述传统将几个王国的建立追溯至十六世纪，其中包括基扬特瓦拉和基齐巴。前者与班坎戈氏族有关，后者则与巴卡马氏族有关。各国统治者治理湖泊西岸的邻近社群。布哈亚通过贸易和政治关系与其他大湖王国相连，咖啡便是受到园地之外的人们珍视的物产之一。

后来的布科巴即位于此地。

english: Hayami lies on the northern shore of Beppu Bay in Bungo. After the Battle of Sekigahara, Kinoshita Nobutoshi received lands here and began building Hiji Castle in 1601. The castle rose above the shore, with its town arranged around the lord's residence. Its position looked across the sheltered bay towards the mountains of central Kyushu, giving the small Hiji domain a coastal seat for its government.
simp_chinese: 速见位于丰后别府湾北岸。关原之战后，木下延俊受封此地，于1601年开始修筑日出城。城堡耸立海岸之上，城下町围绕领主居馆展开。隔着平静的海湾，可以望见九州中部群山；日出藩由此获得了一处海滨治所。

english: The Hayes River flows from Molson Lake through northern Manitoba to Hudson Bay, crossing a country of spruce woods, bogs and numerous waterways. Indigenous peoples travelled and camped along its course long before the arrival of Europeans. In 1684 the Hudson's Bay Company established York Factory at its mouth. The Hayes became a principal route between the bay and the interior, carrying traders and canoe brigades through the lake country towards Norway House.
simp_chinese: 海斯河从莫尔森湖出发，穿过曼尼托巴北部注入哈德孙湾，沿途有云杉林、泥沼和众多水道。欧洲人到来之前，原住民已沿河旅行并扎营。1684年，哈德孙湾公司在河口建立约克工厂。此后，海斯河成为海湾与内陆之间的主要路线，商人和独木舟队沿河穿过湖泊地区，前往挪威之家。

english: Haylan lies in the northern Somali highlands, among a landscape of old settlements and ruined structures. It is associated with the tomb of Sheikh Darod, remembered in tradition as the ancestor of the Darod clan. The highlands stand above the dry coastal country, their valleys and passes linking communities across northern Somalia.
simp_chinese: 海兰位于索马里北部高地，周围分布着古老聚落和建筑遗迹。这里与谢赫达罗德的陵墓相关；传统将他视为达罗德氏族的祖先。高地耸立在干燥的海岸地区之上，山谷与通道连接着索马里北部的社群。

english:
Haymana lies on the central Anatolian plateau south of Ankara. The surrounding district preserves evidence of ancient settlement, including the stronghold of Gavur Kalesi and burial mounds at Türkhöyük and Oyaca. Roman and Byzantine rule gave way to the Seljuks, and the region later came under Ilkhanid authority after the Mongol victory at Köse Dağ.

The Ottomans incorporated the area in the mid-fourteenth century. Their authority was interrupted after Timur defeated Bayezid near Ankara in 1402, before Ottoman control returned. Haymana's location placed it within the changing political landscape of inland Anatolia, while its settlements remained connected to the surrounding plateau.
simp_chinese:
哈伊马纳位于安卡拉以南的安纳托利亚中部高原。周边地区保存着古代聚居遗迹，包括加武尔卡莱西要塞以及图尔克许于克和奥亚贾的墓丘。罗马和拜占庭统治之后，塞尔柱人控制了这一地区；蒙古人在克塞山获胜后，这里又处于伊儿汗国权力之下。

十四世纪中叶，奥斯曼将这一地区纳入版图。1402年帖木儿在安卡拉附近击败巴耶济德后，奥斯曼统治一度中断，随后重新恢复。哈伊马纳位于不断变化的安纳托利亚内陆政治格局之中，其聚落也与周围高原保持联系。

english:
The Hainai lived along the Neches and Angelina rivers in the wooded country of eastern Texas. They were a leading people of the Hasinai confederacy, whose communities grew maize, beans and squash and lived in riverine settlements. The confederacy was centered on a Hainai village, where a religious leader known as the chenesi held authority among the chiefs of its constituent peoples. The chiefs met in councils to conduct important business.

In 1716 Spanish Franciscans established the mission of Nuestra Señora de la Purísima Concepción among the Hainai. The new mission struggled with shortages, drought and disease, while its agricultural neighbors continued to live in the surrounding country. Spanish and French interests both reached the Hasinai, who navigated their relations with the competing colonial powers.
simp_chinese:
海奈人生活在得克萨斯东部林地中的内奇斯河与安赫利纳河沿岸。他们是哈西奈联盟的重要成员；联盟各社群在河边聚居，种植玉米、豆类和南瓜。联盟以一座海奈村落为中心，称作切内西的宗教领袖在各族首领之间享有权威。各族首领在会议上商议重要事务。

1716年，西班牙方济各会士在海奈人中建立圣母无染原罪传教站。新传教站面临物资短缺、旱灾和疾病，周围的农耕居民则继续生活在自己的土地上。西班牙与法国的势力都延伸到哈西奈地区，当地人周旋于相互竞争的殖民势力之间。

english:
Lake Hayq's island monastery of Istifanos was a centre of Ethiopian Christian learning and patronage. Its thirteenth-century development was associated with the abbot Iyasus Mo'a and the restored Solomonic monarchy. An illustrated Gospel commissioned by the abbot accumulated later notes recording land, possessions and transactions, linking monastic learning to material obligations and relationships with the surrounding world.

The lake did not make the community invulnerable. In 1531 Ahmad ibn Ibrahim's forces built rafts to cross to the island. The monks surrendered valuables to save their home from destruction, and the monastery was plundered. Surviving manuscripts and a fifteenth-century icon nevertheless preserve parts of a tradition that endured warfare and the loss of wealth.
simp_chinese:
海格湖中的伊斯提法诺斯修道院，是埃塞俄比亚基督教学术与赞助关系的中心。十三世纪的发展与院长伊亚苏斯·莫阿及恢复统治的所罗门王朝相连。院长委托制作的彩绘《福音书》，后来不断增入有关土地、财物和交易的笔记，使修道学术与周围社会的实际义务和联系一同保存在书页中。

湖泊并未使社群免于战祸。1531年，艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣的军队制作木筏渡往湖岛。修士交出贵重物品，试图保全住处，修道院仍遭洗劫。留存手稿与十五世纪圣像，保存了经历战争和财富损失之后延续的宗教传统。

english: Hayrabolu lies inland in Thrace, between the roads to Adrianople and the Sea of Marmara. Known in Byzantine times as Chariopolis, it was the seat of a bishop and a place where John Kantakouzenos resided during the civil wars of the fourteenth century. Ottoman forces took the town later in that century. It subsequently served as winter quarters for armies on campaign, and in 1499 Güzelce Hasan Bey endowed a stone mosque here with revenues from villages near Dimetoka.
simp_chinese: 海拉博卢位于色雷斯内陆，介于通往阿德里安堡和马尔马拉海的道路之间。拜占庭时代，这座主教驻地称为卡里奥波利斯；十四世纪内战期间，约翰·坎塔库泽努斯曾在此居住。同一世纪稍后，奥斯曼军队夺取城镇。此后，海拉博卢成为出征军队的冬营地；1499年，居泽尔杰·哈桑贝伊在此捐建一座石砌清真寺，并将季梅托卡附近村庄的收入拨作基金。

english:
Hays stands on the Tihama plain south of Zabid, on a route between the coastal lowlands and Taizz. Its potters used the region's clay to make vessels valued throughout Yemen, including water jars, oil containers and small cups. The town was a stopping place for travellers and merchants; Rasulid rulers also passed through it between their centres at Taizz and Zabid.

In the eighteenth century the Danish traveller Carsten Niebuhr recorded the pottery workshops of Hays and the large part of Yemen supplied by their wares. He noted especially the cups used for drinks made from coffee and its husks. The kilns and workshops of Hays belonged to a craft tradition shared with other towns of the Tihama, where potters shaped and fired the clay of the plain into vessels for everyday use.
simp_chinese:
海斯位于宰比德以南的提哈马平原，处在沿海低地与塔伊兹之间的道路上。陶工用当地黏土制作深受也门各地欢迎的器皿，包括水罐、油壶和小杯。城镇是旅人和商人的歇脚处，拉苏尔王朝统治者往来于塔伊兹与宰比德两个中心时也经过这里。

十八世纪，丹麦旅行家卡斯滕·尼布尔记载了海斯的陶器作坊，以及其产品供应也门广大地区的情况。他特别提到饮用咖啡及咖啡壳饮料的小杯。海斯的窑炉与作坊属于提哈马各城镇共有的手工传统，陶工将平原黏土塑形、烧制成日常器皿。

english: Hazarasp, whose Persian name means “a thousand horses”, was an important fortified town of Khwarazm near the lower Oxus. Excavations have revealed a large citadel and strong walls, reflecting the town's place among the defended settlements of the oasis. In 1147 the Seljuk sultan Sanjar besieged its fortress during his campaign against the Khwarazmshah Atsiz. The Mongol invasion later destroyed the town, but it was rebuilt and served as a stronghold and residence of rulers of the Arabshahid line.
simp_chinese: 哈佐拉斯普的波斯语名意为“一千匹马”，是阿姆河下游附近花剌子模的重要设防城镇。发掘揭示了一座大型城堡和坚固城墙，显示它在绿洲诸多设防聚落中的地位。1147年，塞尔柱苏丹桑贾尔征讨花剌子模沙阿忒思时围攻此堡。蒙古入侵后来毁坏了城镇，但它得以重建，并成为阿拉伯沙希王朝统治者的据点和居所。

english:
Hazaribagh stands on the high central plateau of Chota Nagpur, surrounded by hills and forests at a cooler elevation than the neighbouring plains. Its position made it a convenient military station for the East India Company as it extended authority over the upland estates. The Ramgarh Battalion, raised in 1780, was stationed here, and the settlement developed around its cantonment.

The Company’s military district included the lands of Ramgarh and neighbouring estates. Following the Kol uprising of 1831–32, the administration of the region was reorganised. Ramgarh, Kharagdiha, Kendi and Kunda were brought into a division with Hazaribagh as its headquarters. Although the town itself was not severely affected by the uprising, the change reflected the Company’s efforts to govern the plateau after the conflict.
simp_chinese:
赫扎里巴克位于乔塔纳格普尔中央高原，周围是丘陵和森林。东印度公司向高地领地扩展权威时，这里的位置使其成为适宜的军事驻地。1780年组建的拉姆加尔营驻扎于此，聚落围绕营地发展。

公司的军事辖区包括拉姆加尔和邻近领地。1831至1832年科尔起义后，该地区的行政体系重新组织，拉姆加尔、卡拉格迪哈、肯迪和昆达被纳入以赫扎里巴克为中心的辖区。尽管城镇本身没有受到起义严重影响，这一变化反映了公司在冲突后治理高原的努力。

english: The Snake River cuts a deep canyon through the volcanic plain of southern Idaho. Downstream from this stretch stand Shoshone Falls, where the river pours over a high rocky ledge. The surrounding plain formed part of the country travelled by Shoshone communities, whose seasonal pursuits included fishing, hunting and gathering roots. In the 1820s, the Hudson's Bay Company trader Peter Skene Ogden recorded encounters with Shoshone people along the Snake, as fur brigades entered the river country in search of beaver.
simp_chinese: 斯内克河在南部的火山平原上切出深峡。河段下游是肖肖尼瀑布，河水从高耸的岩坎倾泻而下。周围的平原是肖肖尼人往来的地区之一，他们随着季节捕鱼、狩猎与采集根茎。十九世纪二十年代，哈德逊湾公司的商人彼得·斯基恩·奥格登记录了沿斯内克河遇见肖肖尼人的经历；当时毛皮商队正进入河流地区寻找河狸。

english: Hazro lies on hilly ground at the southern foot of Mount Uzuncaeski, east of Diyarbakır. Above the district stands the ruined fortress of Tercil, a reminder of the many powers that held this mountainous frontier. Hazro itself passed between local Muslim dynasties and emirates after the early Islamic conquests. Under the Ottomans, Hazzo was counted among the hereditary Kurdish lordships of the Diyarbakır province, whose local rulers retained authority over their revenues.
simp_chinese: 哈兹罗位于迪亚巴克尔以东、乌尊贾埃斯基山南麓的丘陵地带。特尔吉尔堡垒的废墟高踞其上，令人想起历代占据这片山地边疆的政权。早期伊斯兰征服之后，哈兹罗曾在地方穆斯林王朝和埃米尔国之间易手。奥斯曼时期，哈佐被列为迪亚巴克尔省的库尔德世袭领地之一，地方领主保有对当地收入的支配权。

english: He Sapa, the Black Hills, rises as a forested island above the surrounding northern Plains. Its dark slopes, high ridges and sheltered valleys form a striking landmark visible from the prairie. For the Lakota and the wider Oceti Sakowin, the hills are a sacred homeland, inseparable from stories of origins and places of ceremony. Other peoples of the Plains also have longstanding ties to this mountain country.
simp_chinese: 黑萨帕，即黑山，如一座森林覆盖的岛屿耸立于北部平原之上。深色山坡、高耸山脊和隐蔽河谷构成草原上醒目的地标。对拉科塔人和更广泛的奥切蒂沙科温诸族而言，黑山是神圣故土，与起源故事和仪式地点密不可分。平原上的其他民族也与这片山地有着长久联系。

english:
Heahdhetanwan belongs to the central Great Plains, where river valleys, grasslands and seasonal animal movements sustained Indigenous communities. The wider region contained both mobile hunters and settled farmers, with maize-growing villages near suitable waterways exchanging food and manufactured goods with people travelling across the plains. Bison supplied meat, hides and materials whose importance extended into housing, clothing and ritual life.

Across the wider Plains, horses spread during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, changing travel and hunting. European goods also entered Indigenous exchange networks through several routes. Farming, hunting and political relationships varied among communities, and knowledge of water and shelter remained important in a landscape of long distances.
simp_chinese:
赫阿德赫坦万属于中央大平原，河谷、草地及季节动物移动支持原住民社群。广大区域既有流动猎人，也有定居农民，适宜水道附近的玉米村落，同穿行平原的人交换粮食与手工业品。野牛提供肉、皮和材料，其意义延伸至住所、衣物和仪式生活。

在更广阔的平原地区，马匹于十七至十八世纪传播，改变了旅行和狩猎。欧洲货物也通过不同路线进入原住民交换网络。各社群的农业、狩猎和政治关系不尽相同；在距离遥远的草原上，对水源和避风处的了解仍然重要。

english: Far south in the Indian Ocean, Heard Island rises from the Kerguelen Plateau. The glacier-covered bulk of Big Ben makes up most of this volcanic island, with Mawson Peak at its summit. Ice descends towards the coast in glaciers, and the smaller Laurens Peninsula projects from the island's northwest. The McDonald Islands lie across the sea to the west, beyond the surf and cold waters surrounding Heard.
simp_chinese: 赫德岛从南印度洋的凯尔盖朗高原上升起。覆盖冰川的比格本火山占据岛屿的大部分，山顶是莫森峰。冰川向海岸下行，较小的劳伦斯半岛从岛的西北端伸出。麦克唐纳群岛位于西方海面，隔着环绕赫德岛的寒冷海水与浪涛。

english: Hebin, “Riverside,” takes its name from an old county on the Yellow River at the eastern end of the Hetao. Its town stood near a crossing where the river turns south, a meeting point for routes from the steppe and the Chinese interior. Under the Liao and Jin the county formed part of a succession of settlements and fortifications along this important stretch of river.
simp_chinese: 河滨得名于河套东端黄河畔的旧县。县城靠近黄河南转处的渡口，草原与中原的道路在此相接。辽金时期，这里与沿河其他城镇、堡垒一起，构成了黄河要道上的聚落网络。

english:
Hebron lies among the hills south of Jerusalem, around a sanctuary revered by Jews, Christians and Muslims as the burial place of Abraham and his family. The great stone enclosure over the Cave of Machpelah dates to the first century, while the Ibrahimi Mosque and the surrounding quarters preserve the work of later builders. Caravan routes from southern Palestine, Sinai and Arabia met here, and the old town's limestone houses, markets and baths grew around the sacred precinct.

Under the Mamluks, Hebron's neighbourhoods acquired much of their enduring form. Ottoman rule brought further expansion, with upper stories added to houses and new buildings rising around the older centre. Glassmaking was a distinctive local craft, practiced by families whose workshops produced lamps and other wares for markets beyond the city. Pilgrims and travellers continued to visit the sanctuary, while merchants connected the town to the surrounding hills and more distant lands.

In 1834 a revolt against Egyptian conscription and other demands spread through Palestine. Ibrahim Pasha's troops attacked Hebron to suppress the resistance, plundering the town and inflicting violence on its inhabitants. The Jewish community, although it had not taken part in the revolt, suffered severely. The sanctuary and the dense streets around it remained central to Hebron's religious and urban life after the fighting.
simp_chinese:
希伯伦位于耶路撒冷以南的丘陵间，城市围绕一处犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教共同尊崇的圣所发展，传统认为亚伯拉罕及其家人安葬于此。麦比拉洞上的巨大石围墙建于公元一世纪，易卜拉欣清真寺和周围街区则保存了后世建筑者的成果。巴勒斯坦南部、西奈和阿拉伯的商队道路在此汇合，石灰岩民居、市场和浴场环绕圣所生长。

马穆鲁克时期，希伯伦各街区形成了延续长久的格局。奥斯曼统治带来进一步扩张，民居增建楼层，旧中心周围出现新建筑。玻璃制造是当地特色手艺，世代工匠制作灯具等产品，销往城外市场。朝圣者和旅人继续前来参拜，商人则将城镇与周围山地及更远的地区联系起来。

1834年，反对埃及征兵和其他要求的起义席卷巴勒斯坦。易卜拉欣帕夏的军队攻打希伯伦镇压抵抗，洗劫城镇并伤害居民。没有参加起义的犹太社群也遭受严重损失。战斗之后，圣所及其周围密集的街巷仍是希伯伦宗教和城市生活的中心。

english:
Heby appears in written sources from the later fourteenth century. In the 1540s it consisted of two tax-paying farms, northeast of the church hill at Västerlövsta. Division of holdings and the addition of outlying land enlarged it to six farms by the late seventeenth century, arranged as a row village. Nearby church lands included both enclosed fields and outlying pasture or woodland.

Västerlövsta's present church was built in the late fifteenth century. Its vaults, made by master mason Anders of Enköping, carried faces and geometric ornaments. Early in the following century the chancel gained narrative paintings, probably by Anders Martinsson. An altarpiece made in Jan de Molder's Antwerp workshop around 1520 depicted Christ's Passion, death and Resurrection. This imported work brought Netherlandish carving into a small Swedish parish. The farms and church together make up the rural history of Heby.
simp_chinese:
海比在十四世纪后半叶已见于文献。1540年代，这里由两户纳税农场组成，位于韦斯特勒夫斯塔教堂山丘的东北面。此后地产分割并纳入外围土地，到十七世纪末扩为六户，形成列状村落。邻近教堂的地产既有围合耕地，也有外围的牧地或林地。

现存韦斯特勒夫斯塔教堂建于十五世纪后期。来自恩雪平的泥瓦匠师安德斯砌筑拱顶，并饰以人脸和几何纹样。十六世纪初，圣坛部分又增添叙事壁画，可能出自安德斯·马丁松之手。约1520年，安特卫普扬·德莫尔德作坊制作的祭坛柜描绘基督受难、死亡与复活，将尼德兰木雕带进这处瑞典乡村教区。村中农场与教堂共同构成了海比的乡村历史。

english: Hechi lies in the mountain country of northwestern Guangxi, on routes linking the province with Guizhou. A county under the Yuan, it belonged to Qingyuan prefecture under the Ming. In 1504 the Ming raised the native county to a prefecture and appointed regular officials to govern it. Hechi continued as a subordinate prefecture of Qingyuan throughout the Qing period.
simp_chinese: 河池位于广西西北山地，是广西与贵州之间的通道之一。元代这里设河池县，明代隶属庆远府。弘治十七年（1504年），朝廷将河池土县升为州，开始派遣流官治理。清代河池州仍隶属庆远府。

english:
Hede grew beside a bend in the Ljusnan, on the route between Sveg and Tännäs. Its parish church became a focus for a scattered farming population, but border warfare repeatedly disrupted that role. In the early seventeenth century the church and village were burned, and inhabitants fled to Norway. Contributions from other parishes helped them rebuild after their return.

Härjedalen passed to Sweden in 1645. When Charles XI visited Hede's church in 1686, he promised support for an assistant priest and gave his portrait. Eighteenth-century craftsmen transformed the building into a centre of local religious art. Jöns Halvarsson-Hedin supplied a carved baptismal angel in 1735; Anders Kjellberg built the onion-domed bell tower in 1751. Enlargement in 1770–1775 was followed by Jöns Ljungberg's rococo furnishings and Pehr Sundin's painting, giving this inland parish a rich artistic inheritance before the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese:
海德在尤斯南河的一处河曲旁发展起来，位于斯韦格与滕奈斯之间的道路上。教区教堂成为分散农户的中心，但边境战争反复打断当地生活。十七世纪初，教堂与村落遭到焚烧，居民逃往挪威；返回之后，其他教区捐款帮助他们重建。

1645年，海里耶达伦转归瑞典。卡尔十一世于1686年到访海德教堂时，承诺资助助理牧师，并赠送自己的肖像。十八世纪的工匠又将建筑装饰成地方宗教艺术的中心：永斯·哈尔瓦松—赫丁于1735年制作雕刻洗礼天使，安德斯·谢尔贝里于1751年建造葱头顶钟楼。教堂在1770至1775年扩建后，又增添永斯·永贝里的洛可可陈设与佩尔·松丁的绘画，使这座内陆教区在十九世纪到来前拥有了丰富的艺术遗产。

english: Hedemora lies in southern Dalarna, near the Dalälven and the mining country of Bergslagen. A market place for the surrounding agricultural and metal-producing districts, it was granted town privileges in the fifteenth century and became Dalarna's oldest town. Roads brought goods from farms and mines to its market, while the river and nearby lakes shaped the settlement's setting. Its church and town institutions gave the district a centre amid the forests and fields of the interior.
simp_chinese: 海德穆拉位于达拉纳南部，靠近达尔河与贝里斯拉根矿业地区。这里是周围农业和金属生产地区的集市，十五世纪获得城市特权，成为达拉纳最古老的城镇。道路将农场和矿山的货品送往市场，河流与附近湖泊塑造了聚落环境。教堂及城镇机构使内陆森林和田野之间形成了一处地方中心。

english: Hedesunda lies beside the lower Dalälven, where the river spreads into broad reaches among islands and wooded shores. Its medieval stone church replaced an earlier wooden building in the thirteenth century and was dedicated to St Michael. In the sixteenth century a brick star vault replaced its wooden ceiling; the church was enlarged in the seventeenth century. Continued structural difficulties and lack of space led the parish to build a new church around the old one in 1775.
simp_chinese: 海德松达位于达尔河下游，河水在岛屿与森林岸边之间展开成宽阔水域。十三世纪，一座献给圣米迦勒的石教堂取代了更早的木建筑。十六世纪，砖砌星形拱顶取代木天花板；十七世纪教堂又得到扩建。持续的结构问题和空间不足促使教区于1775年在旧教堂外建造新教堂。

english: Castle Hedingham grew beneath the stronghold of the de Vere family, earls of Oxford. Its great Norman keep rises above the Essex countryside, a reminder of the power of the family that held the manor after the Conquest. A market was already established by 1216, and the settlement developed as a small castle town alongside the de Veres' residence.
simp_chinese: 卡斯尔赫丁厄姆兴起于德维尔家族的堡垒脚下。这个家族受封牛津伯爵，在诺曼征服后掌握了此地庄园；高耸于埃塞克斯乡间的诺曼主塔，至今仍见证着他们的权势。1216年以前，当地已有市场，聚落在德维尔家族的居所旁发展为一座小小的城堡镇。

english: The sea off Hedland borders the Pilbara coast of Western Australia, where tidal creeks and low shores open onto the Indian Ocean. The surrounding country belongs to Aboriginal peoples including the Kariyarra. In 1699 William Dampier sailed along the wider northwestern coast in the Roebuck, charting shores already known to their inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 黑德兰外海毗邻西澳大利亚皮尔巴拉海岸，潮汐溪流和低矮海岸通向印度洋。周围土地属于包括卡里亚拉人在内的原住民诸族。1699年威廉·丹皮尔乘罗巴克号沿更广阔的西北海岸航行，绘制当地居民早已熟悉的海岸。

english: Hedmarksvidda is an upland area of forests, marshes and lakes east of Mjøsa. It rises above the fertile farming country around Hamar, offering summer grazing beyond the settled lowlands. Farms sent livestock to mountain pastures in the warmer months, bringing the woodland plateau into the seasonal working life of the surrounding villages.
simp_chinese: 海德马克高原位于米约萨湖以东，是一片遍布森林、沼泽和湖泊的高地。它高出哈马尔周围肥沃的农区，为低地聚落提供夏季牧场。暖季里，农庄将牲畜赶往山地放牧，使这片林木覆盖的高原成为周围村落季节性生活的一部分。

english: Hedo Cape marks the northern end of Okinawa Island, where limestone cliffs face both the East China Sea and the Pacific. Waves break against the steep shore, while wind-shaped plants grow above it. Inland, the limestone of Mount Hedo has been worn into karst formations by water. The island of Yoron lies beyond the sea to the north, across the passage separating Okinawa from the Amami group.
simp_chinese: 边户岬是冲绳岛的最北端，石灰岩峭壁同时面向东海与太平洋。浪涛拍打陡岸，崖上生长着受海风塑形的植物。向内陆望去，边户岳的石灰岩经水侵蚀形成喀斯特地貌。北方海峡之外是与论岛，隔海与冲绳相望，属于奄美群岛。

english:
Hédōng was the county seated beside Hezhong Prefecture, on the east bank of the Yellow River where the great bend carries the roads of Shanxi and Shaanxi together. The Song, Jin and Yuan all kept a county of this name at the prefectural seat, a busy crossing and market. The Yuan playwright Wang Shifu set his drama of the student and the maiden, the Xixiang ji, at the Pujiu Temple on the plain beside the town.

In 1369 the Ming abolished the county and merged it into Puzhou. On 23 January 1556 a catastrophic earthquake struck the Shaanxi and Shanxi border country, and Yongji was among the worst-hit districts. In 1724 the Qing made Puzhou an independent department and in 1728 a prefecture, with a new seat county named Yongji, after the Yongji canal.
simp_chinese:
河东是河中府的附郭县，位于黄河东岸，大河湾把晋陕两地的道路汇聚到一处。宋、金、元三代都在府治设有同名的县，这里是一处繁忙的渡口和市场。元代剧作家王实甫写下的爱情剧《西厢记》，故事便发生在城旁平原上的普救寺。

1369年，明朝撤销河东县，并入蒲州。1556年1月23日，陕西与山西交界地区发生特大地震，永济一带是受灾最重的地方之一。1724年，清朝把蒲州升为直隶州，1728年又升为府，并在府治设立新的附郭县，以境内的永济渠命名为永济县。

english:
Heeyoteyoo, “Long Mountain” in Arapaho, rises above the eastern edge of the Rocky Mountains. Known to later travelers as Pikes Peak, its summit towers over the plains and can be seen far to the east. The mountain and its surrounding valleys belong to a landscape crossed by Indigenous peoples long before permanent European settlement. Its streams descend toward Fountain Creek and the Arkansas River, linking the high country with the plains below.

The later city of Colorado Springs lies here.
simp_chinese:
赫约特约在阿拉帕霍语中意为“长山”，耸立于落基山东缘。这座后来被称为派克斯峰的高山俯瞰平原，从很远的东方即可望见。早在欧洲人永久定居之前，原住民便穿行于山峰及周围河谷。山间溪流流向喷泉溪与阿肯色河，将高地与下方平原联系起来。

后来的科罗拉多斯普林斯即位于此地。

english: Héféi, the seat of Lúzhōu, lies north of Cháo Lake amid the waterways between the Yangtze and Huái. It was the home of the Sòng official Bāo Zhěng, remembered for his stern justice. In 1488 the Míng prefect Sòng Kèmíng established Bāo Gōng Academy on Xiānghuā Islet, a place traditionally associated with the scholar’s youth.
simp_chinese: 合肥是庐州治所，位于巢湖以北、江淮之间的水乡。宋代官员包拯出身于此，因执法严正而为人铭记。明弘治元年（1488年），庐州知府宋克明在香花墩建包公书院；传说包拯少年时曾在此读书。

english: Héhé is the old name of Xing County, in the valleys on the western slope of the Lüliang mountains, east of the Yellow River. The Tang and Song kept a county of that name, the Jin raised the place to Xingzhou, and the Yuan held it as a lesser department. In 1261 the name Hehe County returned for a single year before Xingzhou was restored. In 1369 the Ming reduced Xingzhou to Xing County, and from 1375 it answered to Kelanzhou in Taiyuan Prefecture. The Qing shifted authority twice: in 1725 the new directly administered department of Baode took Xing County under it, and in 1730 it was returned to Taiyuan Prefecture.
simp_chinese: 合河是今山西兴县的旧名，位于吕梁山西麓的河谷之中，黄河以东。唐宋时这里设有同名的县；金代升为兴州，元代将它保留为较小的下州。1261年，合河县之名曾恢复了一年，随后兴州之名又被重新启用。1369年，明朝把兴州降为兴县，1375年起改隶太原府岢岚州。清代这里的隶属两次变动：1725年，保德州升为直隶州，兴县划归它统辖；1730年，兴县又重新归太原府管辖，前后不过短短几年，隶属关系便转了一圈。

english: The Heévâhetaneo’o, also called Hevhaitaneo, were a Cheyenne band of the Great Plains. Their communities traveled through a country of rivers and grasslands, maintaining ties with related Cheyenne and Arapaho bands. The Oévemanaho and Hisiometaneo were associated with them. In the 1820s southern Cheyenne groups moved from the Platte country toward the Arkansas River, bringing them into closer contact with peoples already living on the southern Plains.
simp_chinese: 赫维泰尼奥人是大平原的一个夏延群体。他们在河流与草原地区迁徙，与亲缘相近的夏延及阿拉帕霍群体保持联系；奥维马纳霍和希西奥梅塔尼奥人都与他们有关。1820年代，南方夏延群体从普拉特河地区向阿肯色河迁移，与早已生活在南部平原的民族产生更密切的接触。

english: Heide takes its name from the heath on which neighbouring villages chose to build a church in the fifteenth century. By 1447 it was already the principal village of Dithmarschen, the North Sea country governed by a community of peasants. Its large market place lay at the heart of this rural centre, where the settlements of the surrounding district gathered. Heide remained a village for centuries before receiving town status.
simp_chinese: 海德得名于一片荒原。十五世纪，附近几个村庄选择在这片荒原上修建教堂。到1447年，它已成为北海沿岸迪特马尔申的主要村落；这片土地当时由农民共同体治理。宽阔的集市广场位于村落中心，是周边聚落的汇集之地。此后数百年，海德仍保持村落地位，直到后来才升为城镇。

english:
In the late 12th century, Heidelberg became the seat of the Count Palatine of the Rhine, and a renowned castle was constructed there. Heidelberg is known for being home to the first German university, and therefore it has a long tradition of educational excellence. Afterwards, it became a center of reformation and tolerance, with the Palatinate eventually becoming the leader of the Protestant Union. The castle and its iconic look attracted many poets to the city in later centuries, earning it the nickname #italic the City of Romanticism#!.

Calvinism made the city's name. Ottheinrich brought in the Reformation in 1556, his successor Frederick III turned the Palatinate to Calvin's teaching, the Heidelberg Catechism appeared in 1563, and students and scholars came from all over western Europe to what was counted a third Geneva after Leiden. Late in the century the castle grew from a medieval stronghold into a Renaissance residence, and Frederick V laid out the Hortus Palatinus there for his English bride, Elizabeth Stuart. His acceptance of the Bohemian crown in 1619 brought the ruin. After his defeat at White Mountain, Tilly took Heidelberg in September 1622, and Maximilian I of Bavaria gave the Palatine Library, kept in the Church of the Holy Spirit, to the pope.

Worse followed when the electoral line died out in 1685 and Louis XIV pressed a claim to the inheritance. French troops took Heidelberg and laid it waste in 1688 and again in 1693, destroying almost every Renaissance house and leaving the castle uninhabitable. The town was rebuilt in Baroque style on its medieval street plan, but when the burghers resisted a new palace on the plain, Elector Charles III Philip moved his court to Mannheim in 1720, and Heidelberg lost both its rank and much of its living. Repairs to the castle stopped after lightning set it ablaze in 1764, and the abandoned ruin was quarried for stone to build the elector's summer palace at Schwetzingen.
simp_chinese:
12世纪晚期，海德堡成为莱茵行宫伯爵的驻地，一座著名城堡在此建造。海德堡因拥有德意志第一所大学而闻名，并因此成为学术中心。之后，它成为宗教改革和宽容的中心，普法尔茨选帝侯最终成为了新教联盟的领袖。再后来，海德堡城堡和它标志性的外观吸引了许多诗人来到这座城市，让这里成为了浪漫主义的象征，为城市应当了#italic 浪漫主义之城#!的美称。

让这座城市声名远播的是加尔文宗。1556年奥特海因里希推行宗教改革，继任的腓特烈三世又让普法尔茨改宗加尔文的学说，1563年《海德堡教理问答》问世，西欧各地的学生和学者纷纷前来，这里被视为继莱顿之后的第三个日内瓦。16世纪末，城堡从中世纪要塞扩建成文艺复兴式的宫邸，腓特烈五世又在这里为英国出身的妻子伊丽莎白·斯图亚特修建了普法尔茨花园。1619年他接受波希米亚王冠，由此招来大祸。白山战败之后，蒂利于1622年9月攻占海德堡，巴伐利亚的马克西米利安一世把藏在圣灵教堂里的普法尔茨图书馆送给了教皇。

更大的灾难在1685年到来：选帝侯一系绝嗣，路易十四借机索要继承权。法军在1688年和1693年两度攻占海德堡，把它彻底蹂躏，城里的文艺复兴式房屋几乎毁尽，城堡也再不能住人。城镇随后按中世纪的街道格局以巴洛克风格重建，但市民反对在平原上另建新宫，选帝侯卡尔三世·菲利普便在1720年把宫廷迁往曼海姆，海德堡既失去了首府地位，也失去了不少生计。1764年雷击引发大火，城堡的修缮就此停止，荒废的废墟被拆下石料，运去修建选帝侯在施韦青根的夏宫。

english:
Heidenheim stands on the Brenz beneath Hellenstein Castle. In Roman times the fort of Aquileia housed a large cavalry unit, and a civilian settlement grew at the meeting of five roads. The medieval town developed alongside the castle; Emperor Charles IV granted or confirmed its market rights in 1356. Through the counts of Helfenstein it came to Württemberg in 1448, although Bavaria and Ulm also held it for a time.

Heidenheim remained the centre of a Württemberg district separated from the duchy's main territory until 1803. Its economy drew on deposits of iron ore, mined and smelted in the district from Roman times. By 1590 a water system carried spring water to a reservoir near the castle to supply the old town. Witch trials between 1607 and 1632 accused ten women; most of the trials ended at the stake. In the early nineteenth century competition from other iron-producing regions diminished the local industry's importance.
simp_chinese:
海登海姆坐落在布伦茨河畔，赫伦施泰因城堡俯瞰着城镇。罗马时代，阿奎莱亚堡驻有一支规模庞大的骑兵，五条道路交会处则发展出民间聚落。中世纪城镇随城堡兴起，1356年皇帝查理四世授予或确认了它的集市权。1448年，海登海姆从赫尔芬施泰因伯爵手中归于符腾堡，巴伐利亚和乌尔姆后来也曾短暂持有此地。

海登海姆始终是符腾堡一个行政区的中心，但直到1803年，该区才与公国主体连成一片。当地经济依靠铁矿，自罗马时代起就有人在此开采和冶炼。到1590年，一套供水系统已将泉水送至城堡附近的水池，供旧城使用。1607年至1632年的猎巫审判牵连十名女子，多数审判以火刑告终。十九世纪初，其他产铁地区的竞争削弱了本地冶铁业的重要性。

english:
Heilbronn grew beside the Neckar, where roads crossed the river and a harbour served the surrounding country. First mentioned in 741, it had a market by the eleventh century and a port by the twelfth. In 1333 an imperial privilege allowed the town to dam and divert the Neckar, directing trade through its harbour and supplying power to its mills. Vineyards on the surrounding slopes contributed to its prosperity.

In 1371 Heilbronn became an imperial city. It embraced the Reformation early: the preacher Johann Lachmann composed a Protestant catechism in 1528, and its mayor joined the Protestation at Speyer the following year. During the Thirty Years' War, the Swedish chancellor Oxenstierna brought Protestant estates together here in the League of Heilbronn in 1633. Occupations and the demands of armies followed, and the city remained a fortified assembly point after the peace. Heilbronn lost its imperial independence to Württemberg in 1802. The Wilhelmskanal, built between 1819 and 1821, helped restore navigation past the river's mills and weirs. Its paper mills adopted large machines around 1820, and by 1832 Heilbronn had more factories than any other town in the kingdom. Its river, once the source of a medieval trading privilege, also powered its early industrial growth.
simp_chinese:
海尔布隆兴起于内卡河畔，道路在此渡河，港口服务于周边地区。此地首次见载于741年，十一世纪已有市场，十二世纪已有港口。1333年，帝国特许城镇筑坝改道，使河上贸易经过其港口，并为磨坊提供水力。周围山坡的葡萄园也为城市带来财富。

1371年，海尔布隆成为帝国城市，并很早接受了宗教改革。传教士约翰·拉赫曼于1528年编写新教教理问答，次年市长参加了施派尔抗议。三十年战争中，瑞典大臣奥克森谢纳于1633年在此召集新教诸邦，组成海尔布隆同盟。此后城市经历军队占领和征索，和平恢复后仍是设防集结地。1802年，海尔布隆失去帝国自由城市地位，归入符腾堡。1819年至1821年修建的威廉运河使船只得以绕过河上的磨坊与堰坝，恢复航运。当地造纸磨坊约在1820年引入大型机器，至1832年，海尔布隆的工厂数量已居王国各城镇之首。曾为中世纪贸易特权提供基础的河流，也推动了这里早期工业的发展。

english:
Heiligenhafen is a Baltic port at the eastern end of the Wagria peninsula. Mentioned several times in the thirteenth century, it received confirmation of Lübeck town law from Count Gerhard II in 1305. In 1325 Count John III allowed its citizens to export their goods without tolls, and the port became the principal outlet for the Oldenburg district.

Fire destroyed almost the whole town in 1391, and King Eric of Denmark laid it waste again in 1428. Rebuilt afterwards, Heiligenhafen suffered anew in the Thirty Years' War and sold the neighbouring village of Klaustorf in 1625 as hardship increased. Plague struck from 1627 to 1630, while later fires and storm floods brought further hardship. Only after 1720 did the small Baltic harbour enjoy a longer period of peace.
simp_chinese:
海利根港位于瓦格里亚半岛东端，是一座波罗的海港口。它在十三世纪的文献中多次出现；1305年，伯爵格哈德二世确认它享有吕贝克城市法。1325年，伯爵约翰三世允许市民免税输出货物，港口逐渐成为奥尔登堡地区的主要出口港。

1391年，大火几乎烧毁全城；1428年，丹麦国王埃里克再次毁坏了这里。海利根港随后重建，却在三十年战争中再遭磨难，并因困境加深于1625年卖掉克劳斯托夫村。1627至1630年的瘟疫使小城濒临破产，后来的火灾与风暴潮又带来困苦。直到1720年以后，港口才迎来较长的和平时期。

english:
The Heiltsuk homeland extends across the islands, channels and deep inlets of the central Pacific coast. Its villages stood in many different parts of this intricate shoreline, some on islands or steep ground that could be defended. Canoes carried people and goods between the coast and neighbouring inlets, where the Heiltsuk traded with other Indigenous communities.

By the 1790s maritime fur traders were visiting these waters, and George Vancouver recorded populous villages during his journeys along the coast. In 1833 the Hudson’s Bay Company built Fort McLoughlin on Campbell Island. A Heiltsuk community grew beside the post, and its traders became important intermediaries: furs brought by Nuxalk visitors from the Bella Coola valley could pass through Heiltsuk hands to European ships and company agents.
simp_chinese:
海尔楚克人的故土横跨太平洋中部海岸的岛屿、水道和深邃峡湾。村庄分布在曲折海岸的许多地方，有些建在岛上或易守的陡峭高地。独木舟运载人们和货物往来于海岸与邻近峡湾，海尔楚克人在那里与其他原住民社群交换物产。

到十八世纪九十年代，海上毛皮商人已来到这一带，乔治·温哥华沿岸航行时记录了人口众多的村庄。1833年，哈德逊湾公司在坎贝尔岛建立麦克洛克林堡，附近逐渐形成一座海尔楚克村庄。当地商人在贸易中充当重要中间人：来自贝拉库拉河谷的努克萨尔人运来毛皮，再由海尔楚克人转售给欧洲船只和公司商人。

english: Heinjoki lies among the lakes and forests of the Karelian Isthmus, east of Vyborg. An old chapel stood on an island in Lake Kaltavesi, with a burial ground used by people of the district. A record from 1645 mentions a marriage celebrated at the chapel by the priest of Muolaa, to whose parish Heinjoki belonged. The island church site brought worshippers together across the water.
simp_chinese: 海因约基位于维堡以东卡累利阿地峡的湖泊和森林之间。卡尔塔韦西湖的一座岛上曾有古老礼拜堂及供当地居民使用的墓地。1645年的记录提到，海因约基所属的穆奥拉教区牧师在礼拜堂主持了一场婚礼。岛上的教堂所在地将水域两岸的信众聚集起来。

english: Heinola lies amid lakes and ridges in southern Finland, where the waters of the Päijänne region pass through the Jyränkö channel. The district was long used by hunters and fishers before permanent villages appeared in the Middle Ages. A parish church was built in 1755. In 1776 King Gustav III made Heinola the residence of a provincial governor, drawing officials, craftsmen and traders to a new administrative centre.
simp_chinese: 黑诺拉位于芬兰南部的湖泊和沙脊之间，派耶讷地区的水流经于兰克水道。中世纪出现永久村落前，猎人和渔民长期利用这片地区。当地于1755年建起教区教堂；1776年，古斯塔夫三世将省总督驻地设于黑诺拉，官员、工匠和商人随之来到这个新的行政中心。

english:
Heinsberg's castle and collegiate church of St Gangolf occupied a divided hill above the town, an unusually commanding position in the Lower Rhine lowlands. The extinction of its ruling dynasty in the fifteenth century changed the castle from a noble residence into the headquarters of a ducal bailiff. In 1484 the lordship passed into the territory of the Duke of Jülich.

From 1538 the duke rebuilt the hilltop defences as a citadel with a powder tower and casemates, adapting an older seat of lordship to artillery warfare. French troops dismantled the fortifications in 1678, leaving a very different landscape of ruined walls around the castle and church. Political boundaries changed again in the revolutionary and Napoleonic era: French administration began in 1794, Prussian rule followed in 1815, and a Heinsberg district was established in 1816. The town thus carried an old seigneurial centre through several successive forms of territorial government.
simp_chinese:
海因斯贝格的城堡与圣甘戈尔夫参事会教堂分据城镇上方一座被壕沟隔开的丘岗，在平坦的下莱茵地区占据难得的制高点。十五世纪，统治家族绝嗣，城堡随之从贵族居所变为公爵派任地方官的驻地。1484年，这片领地并入于利希公爵的辖境。

1538年起，公爵将丘顶防御设施改建为配备火药塔与炮廓的堡垒，使旧领主据点适应火炮战争。1678年，法国军队拆毁防御工事，城堡与教堂周围留下残墙。革命与拿破仑时代又改变了政治归属：1794年开始实行法国行政管理，1815年转归普鲁士，1816年设立海因斯贝格行政区。这个古老领主中心由此经历了数种不同的地方统治体系。

english: Heishui takes its name from the dark waters of a tributary of the upper Min River. Deep valleys cut through the mountains here, with snow peaks rising above wooded slopes and settlements. Tibetan and Qiang communities inhabit the region, where old stone carvings and fortified residences recall a long local history. In the Qing period, the chiefdoms of Greater and Lesser Heishui were associated with Maozhou. The river and its tributaries provide the chief routes through a landscape divided by steep ridges.
simp_chinese: 黑水因岷江上游一条水色深暗的支流而得名。深谷切开群山，雪峰高耸于林坡和聚落之上。这里有藏、羌等社群，古老石刻与官寨留存着地方历史的痕迹。清代曾设大、小黑水土司，隶属茂州；黑水河及其支流构成穿行于陡峭山岭之间的重要通道。

english:
Heizhang was the former name of present-day Hezhang, in the Wusa highlands of northwestern Guizhou. Earlier it was known as Motechuan, a name associated with the river beside the settlement. A relay station had already been established here under the Yuan. In 1382, Fu Youde's Ming army advanced east from Wusa, killed the local chief An Zhengbang and built an earthen-walled stronghold on the southern bank of the Qian River.

The settlement remained tied to the Wusa road. In 1387, its station was ordered to hold grain for men assigned to military service as punishment. Warfare destroyed the earthen fort in 1572, after which defence rested with military farming units. The Qing re-established this transport role: Heizhang was among the relay posts organised on the Wusa route in 1738, under Weining's jurisdiction. During the Jiaqing reign, the station employed more than two hundred labourers, making the movement of people and supplies an enduring part of local history.
simp_chinese:
黑张即今贵州西北乌撒高地的赫章，早称墨特川，与聚落旁的河流同名，元代已设驿站。1382年，傅友德率明军由乌撒东进，杀死地方土目安正邦，在前河南岸修筑土城。

此后聚落继续与乌撒驿道相连。1387年，墨特川站奉令储粮，供给被谪戍人员；1572年土城毁于战乱，防务随后由屯田军承担。清代又整顿这一交通体系，1738年设置的乌撒道铺站包括黑章铺，归威宁管辖。嘉庆年间，黑章站有人夫二百余名。堡城、军粮、屯田与驿站先后汇聚于此，人员和物资转运因而成为贯穿地方历史的重要事务，也把这处山地聚落接入跨越乌撒的行政与军事路线。

english:
Hejian was the seat of a large prefecture south of the Ming capital. In 1368 the new dynasty changed the Yuan administration of Hejian Circuit into Hejian Prefecture. Its jurisdiction eventually included the subordinate prefectures of Jingzhou and Cangzhou and sixteen counties. The city contained both the prefectural headquarters and the office governing Hejian County, two distinct levels of administration occupying neighbouring sites.

The local gazetteer records repeated repairs to the prefectural offices after warfare and fire. Prefect Jia Zhong rebuilt them in 1470, and their scale expanded again early in the Hongzhi reign. A fire in 1511 reduced the offices to ashes, requiring another reconstruction. The headquarters comprised much more than an audience hall: offices dealt with grain, waterways, military registration and judicial business, while stores, a prison and clerks' quarters supported their work. In 1370 the county office was moved south of the prefectural headquarters. This concentration of offices made Hejian a working administrative centre for a substantial part of the northern plain.
simp_chinese:
河间是明代京城以南的一座大府治所。1368年，明朝将元代河间路改为河间府，后来辖景州、沧州及十六县。城中同时设有府署与河间县署，相邻的衙门代表两个不同层级的地方行政机构。

地方志记载，府署屡因战火与火灾毁坏，也屡经修葺。1470年，知府贾忠重建府署，弘治初年又扩充规模。1511年，一场火灾使衙署化为灰烬，随后再次修复。府署不只有升堂办公的大堂，还包括处理粮储、河务、军籍和刑狱等事务的机构，以及仓库、监狱和吏员房舍。1370年，河间县署迁至府署以南。这些机构集中于城内，使河间成为统辖华北平原大片地区的行政中心。

english: Hejiang takes its name from the meeting of rivers: the Chishui and Xishui join the Yangtze among the hills east of Luzhou. The Chishui provided a water route towards the mountains of Guizhou, though its course was not easy to navigate. The warm, moist country around the confluence is also known for its lychees, cultivated here far inland from the southern coast.
simp_chinese: 合江因江河汇合而得名：赤水河、习水河在泸州以东的丘陵间汇入长江。赤水河提供了一条通往贵州山区的水路，航行却并不容易。河口附近气候温暖湿润，也以荔枝著称；这里远离南方海岸，却有悠久的荔枝栽培传统。

english: Hejin lies near the Yellow River's passage through the narrow Dragon Gate, where steep banks frame an important crossing between Shanxi and Shaanxi. The ferry at Yumenkou, northwest of the county town, was known in earlier records as Dragon Gate Pass. Boats could cross the confined channel, and its position made it a strategic point as well as a route for travellers. The Ming established a patrol office at the ferry, an arrangement continued by the Qing.
simp_chinese: 河津靠近黄河穿过龙门的狭窄河段，两岸险峻，是山西与陕西之间的重要渡口。县城西北的禹门渡在古籍中又称龙门关，船只可由此横渡，既是行旅通道，也是战略要地。明代在渡口设置巡检司，清代沿用。

english: Hekikai lies in western Mikawa, where the Mizuno family held Kariya Castle. Mizuno Katsunari, a cousin of Tokugawa Ieyasu, became its lord in 1600 after succeeding his father. Kariya later passed through several houses of hereditary Tokugawa retainers, forming a small domain whose rulers changed frequently. The castle town stood near the Tōkaidō and the waterways of Mikawa, connecting its lords' lands with the traffic of the region.
simp_chinese: 碧海位于三河西部，水野氏曾拥有当地的刈谷城。德川家康的表亲水野胜成继承父亲后，于1600年成为城主。此后刈谷藩多次易主，由不同的德川谱代家臣治理。城下町靠近东海道与三河水路，使领地与地区交通相连。

english:
Heuksando, the Black Mountain islands off southwestern Korea, became a place of exile under the Joseon monarchy. In 1801 the scholar Jeong Yak-jeon was banished there following the persecution of Catholics. He taught children at a small school and turned his attention to the sea around his place of exile, gathering information from island residents as well as examining marine creatures himself.

The resulting Jasan eobo, probably completed in 1814, recorded fish, shellfish and other marine life. Its descriptions included local names, appearance, habits, taste, capture and practical uses. A resident named Jang Deok-sun helped Jeong investigate and classify the creatures, making island knowledge part of the work. The surviving copies divide their contents among scaled creatures, scaleless creatures, shell-bearing animals and miscellaneous marine life. Jeong remained in exile until his death in 1816 on Uido, within the wider Heuksan island setting. His work preserves a detailed encounter between a displaced scholar and the livelihoods and knowledge of the islanders.
simp_chinese:
朝鲜西南海上的黑山诸岛曾是朝鲜王朝的流放地。1801年，学者丁若铨因天主教迫害事件被流放至此。他在当地设塾教导儿童，也开始研究流放地周围的海洋，亲自观察海中生物，并向岛民请教。

由此写成的《玆山鱼谱》大约完成于1814年，记录鱼、贝及其他海洋生物，包括当地名称、形态、习性、味道、捕捉方法和用途。岛民张德顺协助丁若铨调查并建立分类体系，使地方知识成为书中重要内容。现存抄本将内容分为有鳞、无鳞、介类及杂类。丁若铨一直未获赦免，1816年在黑山诸岛范围内的牛耳岛去世。他的著作保存了流放学者与岛民生计、海洋知识相遇的具体记录。

english: South of the Pattiw islands, Helene lies in the central Carolines beyond Pulusuk. The latter is a small island at the end of a submerged atoll some fifty-five kilometres long, west of Chuuk. In 1799 Juan Antonio de Ibargoitia sighted Pulusuk from the Spanish vessel Filipino and charted it under the name Bartolomé.
simp_chinese: 海伦位于帕蒂乌群岛以南的加罗林群岛中部，远在普卢苏克之外。普卢苏克是楚克以西的一座小岛，坐落于一座长约55公里的水下环礁末端。1799年，胡安·安东尼奥·德·伊瓦尔戈伊蒂亚从西班牙船“菲律宾人”号上望见普卢苏克，将其以巴托洛梅之名绘入海图。

english: South of Pulusuk, this stretch of the Caroline Sea lies beyond the Pattiw group west of Chuuk. Pulusuk stands at one end of a long submerged atoll, while Poluwat lies farther northwest. In 1801 the Spanish officer Juan Antonio de Ibargoitia reached Poluwat aboard Filipino, two years after recording Pulusuk.
simp_chinese: 普卢苏克以南的这片加罗林海位于楚克以西帕蒂乌群岛之外。普卢苏克坐落在一座漫长水下环礁的末端，普卢瓦特则位于更远的西北方。1801年，西班牙军官胡安·安东尼奥·德·伊瓦尔戈伊蒂亚乘“菲律宾人”号抵达普卢瓦特，两年前他曾记录普卢苏克。

english:
Helfenstein Castle crowns a spur above Geislingen, on the edge of the Swabian Jura. Built in the early twelfth century, it was the ancestral seat of the counts of Helfenstein, whose lands by the mid-fourteenth century stretched around Geislingen, Heidenheim, Blaubeuren and Wiesensteig. The imperial city of Ulm took the castle as a pledge in 1382 and bought it outright in 1396, strengthening its defences for the age of artillery.

In 1552, during the Second Margrave War, Margrave Albert Alcibiades of Brandenburg-Kulmbach seized the fortress without a siege. Ulm's forces bombarded the occupying garrison with heavy stone cannon shot for several days and recovered it that August. Rather than leave the stronghold to be taken again, the city then demolished its own fortress.
simp_chinese:
黑尔芬施泰因城堡屹立在施瓦本山地边缘的山岬上，俯瞰盖斯林根。城堡建于十二世纪初，是黑尔芬施泰因伯爵家族的祖居；到十四世纪中叶，其领地已分布于盖斯林根、海登海姆、布劳博伊伦和维森施泰格周围。1382年，帝国城市乌尔姆取得城堡作为抵押，1396年又将其买下，随后为适应火炮时代而加强防御。

1552年第二次边侯战争期间，勃兰登堡—库尔姆巴赫边侯阿尔布雷希特·阿尔齐比亚德斯不经围攻便夺取了堡垒。乌尔姆军队以沉重的石弹炮击驻军数日，于当年八月收复城堡。为防要塞再次落入敌手，乌尔姆随后拆毁了这座属于自己的堡垒。

english: Heligoland rises from the German Bight, a small red sandstone island far from the low coasts of the North Sea. Its position near the approaches to the Elbe and Weser gave it value to sailors and merchants. Denmark held the island from 1714 until British forces occupied it in 1807. During the Napoleonic wars it became a centre for trade and smuggling around the restrictions imposed on British goods.
simp_chinese: 黑尔戈兰岛耸立在德意志湾中，是远离北海低平海岸的一座红砂岩小岛。靠近易北河和威悉河入口的位置使它对水手与商人有重要价值。丹麦从1714年统治此岛，直到1807年英军占领。拿破仑战争期间，它成为绕过英国货物贸易限制的贸易和走私中心。

english: Hellín grew around the fortress on the Cerro del Castillo, a stronghold dating from Almohad rule. Its older streets descend the hillside below the castle. After the Christian conquest, the parish church of the Assumption was begun in 1499; its architecture shows the passage from late Gothic forms to the classical language of the Renaissance, reflecting the town’s changing fortunes at the end of the Middle Ages.
simp_chinese: 埃林围绕城堡山上的要塞发展起来，这座堡垒始建于穆瓦希德统治时期。古老街巷从城堡下方沿山坡延伸。基督徒征服后，圣母升天堂于1499年动工；建筑从晚期哥特式逐渐过渡到文艺复兴的古典形式，反映了中世纪末城镇命运的变化。

english:
Helmond grew among the streams of eastern Brabant under the protection of a castle. Duke Henry I founded the town in 1225 and granted its privileges in 1232. A later stone castle and ramparts marked the town's medieval defenses. Market rights granted in 1376 helped its textile trade develop, and seven guilds were authorized in 1389. Helmond merchants sold wool and cloth across Brabant, though the town remained small.

War disrupted this prosperity. Maarten van Rossum's army besieged and sacked Helmond in 1543, and during the Eighty Years' War Dutch forces captured the town twice while the castle held out. War and a plague outbreak in 1636 damaged the textile industry, sending weavers to Haarlem. After peace in 1648, connections with Haarlem merchants helped the trade recover. French occupation at the end of the eighteenth century brought further political changes, including renewed Catholic participation in town government.
simp_chinese:
海尔蒙德在东布拉班特的溪流之间、城堡保护下发展起来。亨利一世公爵于1225年建城，1232年授予特权。后来的石城堡和土垒构成中世纪城防。1376年获得的市场权促进纺织贸易，1389年七个行会获准活动。海尔蒙德商人在布拉班特各地销售羊毛和布匹，尽管城镇规模仍不大。

战争打断了繁荣。1543年马尔滕·范·罗瑟姆的军队围攻并洗劫海尔蒙德；八十年战争期间，荷兰军队两次夺取城镇，而城堡仍坚持不降。战争和1636年瘟疫重创纺织业，织工逃往哈勒姆。1648年和平后，与哈勒姆商人的联系帮助贸易恢复。十八世纪末的法国占领带来进一步政治变化，天主教徒得以重新参与市政管理。

english: Helmstedt grew in the eastern lands of Brunswick, associated with the Benedictine abbey of Saint Ludger. Its churches and monastic institutions long shaped the town before a new foundation made it a centre of Protestant scholarship. Duke Julius of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel introduced the Reformation in his lands and established a university at Helmstedt, ceremonially opened on 15 October 1576. The duke's successor Henry Julius provided a grand Renaissance building, the Juleum Novum, constructed between 1592 and 1597. Scholars taught theology, law, medicine and philosophy, and the university remained an important place of learning through the seventeenth century. In 1810, during the Napoleonic period, it was closed after more than two centuries of teaching.
simp_chinese: 黑尔姆施泰特兴起于不伦瑞克东部领地，与圣卢德格本笃会修道院关系密切。教堂和修院长期塑造着城镇面貌，后来一所新机构使它成为新教学术中心。不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公爵尤利乌斯在领地推行宗教改革，并在黑尔姆施泰特创办大学，1576年10月15日隆重开学。他的继承人海因里希·尤利乌斯为大学兴建宏伟的文艺复兴建筑「新尤莱乌姆」，1592至1597年完工。学者在此教授神学、法律、医学和哲学，大学在十七世纪仍是重要的学术场所。1810年拿破仑时期，大学在教学两个多世纪后关闭。

english: Helong lies in a valley north of the Tumen River, amid the hills of the Changbai country. Nearby stands the old walled site of Xigucheng, commonly identified with Zhongjing Xiande, one of the capitals of Balhae. The kingdom governed a wide territory of forests and river valleys before the Khitan conquest in 926. Its earthen walls and palace remains recall a time when the valley formed part of a network of cities linking the inland capital to routes toward the eastern sea.
simp_chinese: 和龙位于图们江以北的山间谷地，属于长白山区。附近西古城通常被认为是渤海国都城之一中京显德府的遗址。926年契丹征服以前，渤海统治着广大的森林和河谷。夯土城墙与宫殿遗迹，让人想起这片谷地曾是城市网络的一环，连接内陆都城与通往东海的道路。

english:
Helsingborg stands at the narrowest part of the Øresund, across the water from Helsingør. Its medieval castle commanded a vital passage between the Baltic and the western seas. The great brick tower built under the Danish king Erik Menved in the early fourteenth century rose above a fortified enclosure containing halls, stores and a chapel. Within the outer walls were quarters for the garrison and places to store provisions and taxes collected for the crown. The town below grew in the shadow of one of Denmark's strongest fortresses, facing the Danish coast across only a short stretch of water.

Scania passed to Sweden in 1658, and the old walls were replaced by earthworks and bastions suited to artillery. During the Scanian War Danish forces took the town and castle in 1676; the Swedes recovered them the following year. In the 1680s Charles XI ordered the fortifications dismantled, preferring to strengthen Landskrona. The tower survived and later became known as Kärnan. It served as a store and prison after the fortress had lost its earlier military role.

Denmark tried once more to recover Scania during the Great Northern War. In 1710 a Swedish army under Magnus Stenbock defeated the Danish force outside Helsingborg, ending the invasion. The narrow sound remained a busy waterway, watched by the solitary tower that had once formed the heart of a royal castle.
simp_chinese:
赫尔辛堡位于厄勒海峡最狭窄处，与赫尔辛格隔水相望。中世纪城堡控制着波罗的海与西方海域之间的重要通道。十四世纪初，丹麦国王埃里克·门韦德时期建起的巨大砖塔高踞设防围墙之上，墙内有厅堂、仓库和礼拜堂。外墙内设有驻军住所，以及储存粮食和王室税收的地方。山下的城镇在丹麦最坚固要塞之一的庇护下成长，与对岸丹麦海岸仅隔一小段水面。

1658年斯科讷转归瑞典，旧城墙被适应火炮作战的土垒和棱堡取代。斯科讷战争中，丹麦军于1676年夺取城镇与城堡，瑞典人次年收复。1680年代，卡尔十一世选择加强兰斯克鲁纳，下令拆除赫尔辛堡的防御工事；塔楼得以保留，后来被称为谢尔南；在要塞失去原先的军事作用后，它被用作仓库和监狱。

大北方战争期间，丹麦再次尝试夺回斯科讷。1710年，马格努斯·斯滕博克率领的瑞典军队在赫尔辛堡城外击败丹麦军，结束了这次入侵。狭窄海峡仍是繁忙航道，昔日王家城堡中心仅存的塔楼俯瞰其上。

english: Helsinge was a parish in southern Finland long before the town of Helsinki was founded on the coast. Its church village stood at a crossing of important roads, and a wooden church was recorded here by 1401. Around 1450 it gave way to the stone church of Saint Lawrence. Medieval paintings once decorated its interior, although the walls had been whitewashed by the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 赫尔辛厄是芬兰南部的一个教区，远早于海岸上的赫尔辛基城。教堂村位于重要道路的交会处，至1401年已有木教堂的记载。约1450年，圣劳伦斯石教堂取而代之。教堂内部曾有中世纪壁画，到18世纪时墙面已被粉刷成白色。

english:
Helsingør stands at the narrowest point of the Øresund, across the water from Helsingborg. A fishing settlement and St Olaf's Church existed here in the Middle Ages, but the town's great fortune came from its command of the strait. Eric of Pomerania developed Helsingør in the 1420s and built the castle of Krogen at Zealand's northeastern tip.

In 1429 Eric established the Sound Dues. Ships passing through the strait stopped at Helsingør to pay the Danish crown, bringing business and wealth to the town. Frederick II rebuilt and enlarged Krogen in the 1570s, naming the Renaissance castle Kronborg. It became the setting of Shakespeare's Hamlet under the English name Elsinore. By 1672 Helsingør had grown into Denmark's third-largest town, its fortunes bound to the traffic between the Baltic and the North Sea.
simp_chinese:
赫尔辛格坐落在厄勒海峡最狭窄处，与对岸的赫尔辛堡隔水相望。中世纪这里已有渔村和圣奥拉夫教堂，但真正使城镇致富的是它对海峡的控制。波美拉尼亚的埃里克在1420年代发展赫尔辛格，并在西兰岛东北端建造克罗根城堡。

1429年，埃里克设立海峡税。通过海峡的船只须在赫尔辛格停靠，向丹麦王室缴费，也为城镇带来贸易和财富。腓特烈二世在1570年代重建并扩建克罗根，将这座文艺复兴城堡命名为克伦堡。莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》以它为背景，使用英语名称埃尔西诺。到1672年，赫尔辛格已成为丹麦第三大城镇，其兴衰与往来波罗的海和北海的船舶息息相关。

english: Hemang lies in the forest country of Twifo, inland from the Gold Coast. Local traditions connect its founding with Akan-speaking migrants who joined earlier Etsi inhabitants. Twifo-Hemang became an important part of the Twifo state, but a dispute over succession divided its ruling house. The region later came under the power of Denkyira. Twifo recovered its independence after Denkyira’s defeat by Asante in 1701, in a struggle in which Twifo also took part.
simp_chinese: 赫芒位于黄金海岸内陆的特威福森林地区。地方传统将其建立与讲阿坎语的移民联系起来，这些移民同早期的埃齐居民融合。特威福－赫芒成为特威福国家的重要组成部分，但继承争端使统治家族分裂。此后地区落入登基拉的势力范围。1701年登基拉被阿散蒂击败后，特威福恢复独立；它也参加了这场斗争。

english: Hemtine lies in the uplands south of the Lulua River valley, near Dibaya. The river descends north from the Lunda highlands towards the Kasai. Along its valley lived communities later known collectively as the Lulua; farther south were the Lwalwa and other peoples of the upper Kasai country.
simp_chinese: 赫姆蒂内位于卢卢阿河谷以南的高地，靠近迪巴亚。卢卢阿河从隆达高地向北流向开赛河。河谷中生活着后来统称为卢卢阿人的诸社群；更南面则是卢瓦卢瓦人和上开赛地区的其他人群。

english: Henashi Cape projects from the western shore of Tsugaru into the Sea of Japan. The rocky headland stands near Fukaura, a harbour on the coast of northern Honshū. Ships rounding the cape encountered an exposed stretch of sea before reaching the shelter of the port. Fishing communities occupied the neighbouring coves, where land and sea meet beneath the hills of the Tsugaru coast.
simp_chinese: 舮作崎从津轻西岸伸入日本海，岩石岬角靠近本州北部海岸的深浦港。船只绕过岬角，须穿越一段迎风海面才能抵达港口的庇护。附近海湾分布着渔村，津轻海岸的山丘在此与大海相接。

english: Henderson is a raised coral island in the southeastern Pacific, its limestone cliffs enclosing a densely vegetated plateau. Archaeological remains show that Polynesians once lived here and obtained material from Pitcairn and other islands. The merchant ship Hercules called in 1819 under Captain James Henderson, whose name became attached to the island.
simp_chinese: 亨德森是东南太平洋的一座隆起珊瑚岛，石灰岩峭壁围绕植被茂密的高原。考古遗迹表明波利尼西亚人曾在此生活，并从皮特凯恩及其他岛屿获得材料。1819年，商船赫拉克勒斯号在詹姆斯·亨德森船长指挥下到访，此岛后来以他命名。

english: Henderson is a raised coral island east of Pitcairn, with a steep coast rising from the Pacific. Archaeological remains testify to an earlier Polynesian population. Pedro Fernández de Quirós probably sighted it in 1606; Captain James Henderson reached it in 1819 aboard the Hercules.
simp_chinese: 亨德森是皮特凯恩以东的一座隆起珊瑚岛，陡峭海岸从太平洋中升起。考古遗迹见证了早期波利尼西亚居民的存在。佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯可能于1606年望见此岛；1819年，詹姆斯·亨德森船长乘“赫拉克勒斯”号抵达。

english: Hendijan stands near the Zohreh River, north of the Persian Gulf. The river spreads into a delta before reaching the sea, carrying sediment through a low coastal landscape. Its channels and tidal waters meet on the plain, while lands farther inland rise towards the hills of southwestern Iran. The river connects the coast with the valleys behind it.
simp_chinese: 亨迪詹位于佐赫雷河附近，处在波斯湾北岸。河流入海前展开为三角洲，携带泥沙穿过低洼海岸地带。河道与潮水在平原上相遇，内陆则逐渐升向伊朗西南部丘陵。河流把海岸与后方河谷连接起来。

english:
Henei was the county at present-day Qinyang in northern Henan, south of the Taihang Mountains. It served as the seat of Huaiqing Route from 1319 and of Huaiqing prefecture after the Ming reorganisation of 1368. The Qing retained this arrangement, placing county and prefectural administration together in the same city.

The town's position connected the Henan plain with routes into southeastern Shanxi. Its historic layout combined gates, princely and administrative compounds, shops, canals and linked ponds. The water system was important both to urban life and to managing drainage in a city close to the Qin River. Trade gave another purpose to these connections: Huaiqing merchants dealt in the region's celebrated medicinal products, including Chinese yam, rehmannia, achyranthes and chrysanthemum. Henei's early modern history consequently belongs to a particular administrative and commercial centre, where official government, river management and exchange across the Taihang approaches met within the same walled town.
simp_chinese:
河内县治位于今河南沁阳、太行山南麓。1319年起，这里是怀庆路治所；1368年明朝改设怀庆府后，仍以河内为府治。清朝沿袭这一安排，使府署和县署同处一城。

城镇连接河南平原与晋东南的山路。其历史格局包括城门、藩府、官署、商铺，以及沟渠相连的湖塘。临近沁河的城市既依赖水系维持生活，也需要处理排水问题。商业则赋予这些联系另一重意义：怀庆商人经营当地著名的山药、地黄、牛膝、菊花等药材。河内的明清历史因此具有明确的地方内容：在同一座城中，府县行政、水利安排与通往太行山口的商业往来彼此交织。

english: The mountains around Dartsedo stand at the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau, where deep valleys descend towards Sichuan. Part of the Hengduan mountain country, these ridges separate high pastoral land from the lower river valleys to the east. The road through Dartsedo has long carried travellers across this difficult barrier between Kham and Sichuan.
simp_chinese: 打箭炉周围的山岭位于青藏高原东缘，深谷向四川方向下降。这片横断山地将高原牧场与东部较低的河谷分隔开来。通过打箭炉的道路长期承载往来旅人，穿越康区与四川之间的险峻屏障。

english: In the northern Hengduan ranges, the Jinsha River runs past Palyul between steep mountain slopes. Tributaries such as the Zengqu and Ouqu cut across the surrounding hills to join it. Above the valley stands Palyul Monastery, established in the seventeenth century with the support of the ruler of Derge and entrusted to Kunzang Sherab.
simp_chinese: 横断山北段，金沙江从白玉山谷穿过，两岸山坡陡峭，赠曲和偶曲等支流从山间汇入。河谷上方的白玉寺于十七世纪在德格王支持下建立，昆桑谢拉受请出任住持。

english:
The Hengduan ranges around Dechang enclosed the lower reaches of the Anning River plain in southwestern Sichuan. Here a relatively broad cultivated valley narrowed towards the mountains and the river's descent to the Yalong. Routes following the Anning linked the Jianchang country around Xichang with Huili and Yunnan, while journeys across the ridges led into quite different river systems and communities.

Under the Yuan, Dechang belonged to the administrative world of the Luoluo frontier. Ming government combined military establishments in the valleys with hereditary native authorities in the surrounding country. These arrangements brought officials and soldiers into continuing negotiation and conflict with Yi leaders, whose power could not be measured simply by the boundaries claimed on an imperial map. The campaigns described in the Ming history show mountain strongholds and alliances between local chiefs shaping the movement of armies. In the Qing period, gazetteers still described Dechang through its mountain frontiers and neighbouring jurisdictions. The valley offered a corridor for government and exchange, but the adjoining heights retained a more fragmented landscape of settlement, authority and passage.
simp_chinese:
德昌一带的横断山地围绕着四川西南安宁河平原的下段。较宽阔的耕作河谷在此逐渐收束，河流继续向雅砻江下降。沿安宁河南北延伸的道路，联系西昌附近的建昌地区、会理与云南；越过山脊，则进入不同水系与社群生活的空间。

元代德昌属于罗罗斯边地行政体系。明代在河谷设立军政机构，又在周边维持世袭土官制度。官员、军队与彝族首领之间不断交涉，也时有冲突，地方权力并不总能依照朝廷划定的疆界落实。《明史》记载的征伐中，山间据点和首领之间的联盟，直接影响军队行进与战事。清代方志仍以山地边界和毗邻辖区描述德昌所。河谷为政务与交换提供通道，相接的高地则保留着更为分散的聚落、权威和通行关系。川滇之间的道路因此既穿行于官府治所，也经过需要地方势力协作的山间地带。

english: The Hengduan Mountains rise in steep ridges around the upper Anning and Dadu valleys. Rivers have cut deep channels through the ranges, leaving narrow corridors between high slopes. The Anning begins on the southern side of the Gongga mountain country and flows south towards the Yalong, while the Dadu drains the mountains farther north. Forests cover many slopes, with colder, more exposed ground on the heights.
simp_chinese: 横断山脉在安宁河上游和大渡河流域周围形成陡峭山岭。河流深切山体，在高坡之间留下狭窄通道。安宁河发源于贡嘎山南麓，向南流向雅砻江；更北面的山地则由大渡河及其支流排水。许多山坡覆盖森林，高处则更寒冷、裸露。

english: The southern Hengduan ranges enclose the uplands of Yanyuan in a maze of ridges, basins and river valleys. West of the Yalong, the mountains continue towards the Sichuan-Yunnan frontier, where Lake Lugu lies among high slopes. The broken terrain divides neighbouring basins from one another, while valleys through the mountains have long offered passages between the highlands and the warmer country along the Jinsha River.
simp_chinese: 横断山脉南段的山岭、盆地和河谷交错，环绕着盐源高地。雅砻江西侧的群山延伸至川滇交界，泸沽湖坐落在高坡之间。崎岖地形将相邻盆地分隔开来，山间谷道则自古为高地与金沙江沿岸较温暖地区之间提供通路。

english: West of Litang, the Hengduan mountains break the eastern Tibetan plateau into high ridges and river valleys. Forested slopes border parts of the grassland country, while passes carry routes between Litang and the valleys of the upper Yangtze. The contrast between high pastoral land and deeply cut waterways is characteristic of this rugged corner of Kham.
simp_chinese: 理塘以西，横断山脉将藏地东部高原分割为高岭与河谷。草地边缘有森林覆盖的山坡，山口道路连接理塘与金沙江上游谷地。高寒牧地和深切水道之间的鲜明反差，是这片康区山地的特点。

english: The Hengduan mountains rise across the country of Derge in eastern Tibet. Their high ridges and deep river valleys divide the land into a succession of separate corridors. The upper Yangtze, here known as the Jinsha, flows through the region as it descends southwards. Crossing between valleys requires long climbs over the ridges that connect the Tibetan plateau to lands farther east.
simp_chinese: 横断山脉横贯藏地东部的德格地区，高山深谷将土地分隔成一道道河谷通道。长江上游在此称为金沙江，流经这一地区并向南下降。往返不同谷地须翻越漫长山岭，山岭连接青藏高原与更东面的土地。

english: North of Derge, the Hengduan highlands form a rugged meeting place of mountains, pasture and river valleys. These ranges mark the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau, where watercourses cut deep routes through the uplands. Snow and altitude make the higher crossings difficult, while the valleys provide sheltered corridors through a landscape of steep and closely spaced ridges.
simp_chinese: 德格以北的横断高地，是山岭、牧场与河谷交错的险峻地带。群山位于青藏高原东缘，河流在高地间切出深谷。积雪和海拔使高处山口难以通行，河谷则在密集陡峭的山脊之间提供较为避风的通道。

english: The northern Hengduan highlands rise among the upper river valleys of Kham. Here the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau is divided by mountain ranges and the headwaters of rivers flowing towards the great valleys farther south. High grazing country lies between the ridges, while snow and altitude make travel over the passes difficult for much of the year.
simp_chinese: 横断山地北部耸立在康区的河流上游。青藏高原东缘被山脉和河流源头切分，水流向南汇入更大的河谷。山脊之间有高寒牧场，积雪与海拔则使山口在一年中很长时间里难以通行。

english: The Hengduan ranges rise around Chamdo in eastern Tibet, where high mountains divide the valleys of great southward-flowing rivers. The waters of the upper Mekong meet near Chamdo before continuing through deeply cut valleys. Ridges and gorges shape travel across Kham, with routes threading the river corridors and crossing high passes between neighbouring valleys.
simp_chinese: 横断山脉在藏地东部昌都一带层叠耸立，高山分隔着向南奔流的大河谷地。湄公河上游的水流在昌都附近汇合，继而穿过深切河谷。山脊与峡谷塑造了康区交通，道路沿河谷蜿蜒，并翻越高山口通往相邻谷地。

english: Héng Mountain rises above the Xiāng River in southern Húnán, revered as the Southern Marchmount among China’s sacred peaks. Its highest summit bears the name of Zhurong, associated with the god of fire, while the Great Temple at the mountain’s foot received pilgrims and offerings. Buddhist and Daoist sanctuaries stood among the forested slopes.
simp_chinese: 衡山耸立于湖南南部湘江之上，是中国五岳中的南岳。最高峰以火神祝融命名，山麓的南岳大庙接纳祭祀与香客；林木覆盖的山坡间还分布着佛寺和道观。

english: Hengshui lies on the Fuyang River, where roads cross the waterways of the Hebei plain. A wooden bridge was built here in 1457, but floods repeatedly damaged the crossing. A stone replacement also suffered when the Hutuo shifted south and joined the Fuyang in 1648. In 1765 the Qing began rebuilding the bridge on a substantial scale; completed the following year, its seven arches received the imperial name Anji, meaning peaceful crossing.
simp_chinese: 衡水位于滏阳河畔，河北平原上的道路在此跨越水道。1457年当地建起木桥，屡遭洪水损毁；后来的石桥也在1648年滹沱河改道汇入滏阳河时受损。清朝于1765年开始大规模重建，次年竣工的七孔石桥获乾隆帝赐名“安济”。

english: Héngyáng stands where rivers meet in southern Húnán. On Shígǔ Mountain north of the old city, a scholar’s reading retreat grew into Shígǔ Academy. In the Sòng it received imperial recognition and land, joining the celebrated academies of the age. Scholars including Zhū Xī and Zhāng Shì later taught there, making the riverside hill a centre of learning.
simp_chinese: 衡阳位于湖南南部的江流交汇处。旧城北面的石鼓山上，一处读书之所发展为石鼓书院。宋代朝廷赐额置田，使其成为著名书院之一；朱熹、张栻等学者后来在此讲学，江畔山丘遂成为学术之地。

english: Heni lies in the rugged highlands north of Diyarbakır, where springs give their name to the town in the local Zazaki tongue. Its Great Mosque dates from the thirteenth century and has a timber roof, an example of the region's medieval religious architecture. The town shared the fortunes of the powers that governed neighbouring Diyarbakır, while its mountain setting placed it among the villages and valleys of the upper Tigris country.
simp_chinese: 海尼位于迪亚巴克尔以北崎岖的高地；当地扎扎其语中的地名与泉水有关。镇上的大清真寺建于十三世纪，采用木屋顶，是这一地区中世纪宗教建筑的实例。海尼与邻近的迪亚巴克尔共同经历历代政权更替，其山地位置使它与底格里斯河上游的村庄和河谷紧密相连。

english: Henley-on-Thames is a market town on the river between Oxfordshire and Berkshire. Its bridge has carried traffic across the Thames since at least the thirteenth century; the old wooden structure was replaced by a five-arched stone bridge in the 1780s. Henley's watermen and bargemen carried malt, timber and other goods downriver to London, returning with supplies for the town and its neighbours. Barley sold in the market fed the prosperous local malting trade.
simp_chinese: 泰晤士河畔亨利是牛津郡与伯克郡之间的一座河畔集镇。至少从十三世纪起，桥梁便在此横跨泰晤士河；十八世纪八十年代，古老的木桥被一座五拱石桥取代。亨利的船夫和驳船工将麦芽、木材等货物顺流运往伦敦，返程时带回城镇及邻近地区所需的物品。市场出售的大麦则供应繁荣的本地麦芽业。

english:
Hennebont stands on the River Blavet, where walls and gates protected a crossing upstream from the Breton coast. Its harbour and river gave the town access to the sea, while its fortifications guarded the road through southern Brittany. In 1342, during the Breton War of Succession, Joan of Flanders defended Hennebont for the Montfort cause while her husband was imprisoned and Charles of Blois besieged it.

The town faced siege again during the Wars of Religion. In 1590 forces loyal to Henry IV took Hennebont, and the Duke of Mercœur, leader of the Catholic League in Brittany, later besieged it with Spanish support. The contested stronghold remained important because it controlled a route between the ports and towns of the southern coast.
simp_chinese:
埃讷邦坐落在布拉韦河畔，城墙与城门保护着布列塔尼海岸上游的渡口。港湾和河流使城镇通海，防御工事则守卫穿过布列塔尼南部的道路。1342年布列塔尼王位继承战争期间，佛兰德的让娜为蒙福尔派守卫埃讷邦，当时她的丈夫被囚，她抵抗布卢瓦的查理围攻。

宗教战争期间，城镇再次遭围。1590年，效忠亨利四世的军队夺取埃讷邦；布列塔尼天主教同盟领袖默克尔公爵后来在西班牙支持下围攻此地。这处争夺中的据点控制南岸港口与城镇之间的道路，因而始终重要。

english: Henslow Bay borders Makira in the eastern Solomon Islands, where mountainous land meets the sea. Communities on Makira traded with Ulawa and southern Malaita before European contact. Álvaro de Mendaña’s expedition visited the island in 1568 and charted part of its coast.
simp_chinese: 亨斯洛湾濒临所罗门群岛东部的马基拉，山地在这里与大海相接。欧洲人接触之前，马基拉社群与乌拉瓦和马莱塔南部进行交换。1568年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚的船队到访该岛，绘制了部分海岸。

english:
Hoeryong stood in the Tumen frontier country where Jurchen communities had maintained close relations with the early Joseon court. In 1434 King Sejong established a garrison in the Almuha area, formerly a Jurchen base, and soon raised it to a protectorate. Kim Jong-seo directed the wider northern expansion.

Hoeryong became one of the Six Garrisons through which Joseon consolidated its northeastern frontier. The neighbouring jurisdictions were not all created at once: additional posts gradually completed the defensive system, with Puryong established in 1449 behind the forward line. The district's fifteenth-century history thus involved the conversion of a contested Jurchen frontier into a chain of Korean military and civil jurisdictions, linking fortified settlements along the Tumen and their hinterland.
simp_chinese:
会宁位于图们江边疆地区，当地女真社区曾与朝鲜王朝初期的朝廷保持密切关系。1434年，世宗在原为女真据点的阿木河地区设置会宁镇，不久升为都护府。金宗瑞负责更大范围的东北拓境事务。

会宁成为朝鲜巩固东北边疆的六镇之一。邻近辖区并非同时建立，新增据点逐步补全防御体系，富宁直到1449年才设于前沿防线后方。因此，会宁十五世纪的地方历史，包括将存在争夺的女真边地改组为朝鲜军事与民政辖区的过程，使图们江沿岸的筑城聚落与后方相连。

english: Moose Mountain rises as a wooded plateau above the prairie of southeastern Saskatchewan, some 200 metres above the surrounding plains. Aspen, birch and poplar grow on the upland, while the grasslands below supported large herds of bison. Indigenous people built a stone medicine wheel on the plateau, and its ring of stones marked a sacred site for ceremonies and vision quests. Cree and Assiniboine bands used the high ground as a landmark on their travels across the plains, and the view from the summit reached far over the open country.
simp_chinese: 麋鹿山是萨斯喀彻温东南部草原之上的一片林木高原，高出周围平原约二百米。高地上生长着白杨、桦树和杨树，下方草原曾有大群野牛。原住民在高原上砌出一座石质药轮，石环标记了仪式与异象求问之地。克里人和阿西尼博因人在穿越平原时以这片高地为路标，从山顶望去，开阔的草原一直延伸到远方。

english: Heping lies in the mountains of northeastern Guangdong near the Jiangxi border. Before it became a county, the district belonged to Longchuan and was known as Heping Dong, a remote country of forested hills. In 1518, after a campaign against the forces of Chi Zhongrong, the Ming official Wang Yangming petitioned to establish a county here. Land was taken from Longchuan and Heyuan, and a town was built the following year. Wang proposed reducing the new community's labour and tax burdens while it recovered from the fighting.
simp_chinese: 和平位于广东东北部山区，邻近江西边界。建县之前，这片林岭幽深的地方称和平峒，属于龙川县。1518年，明代官员王阳明在镇压池仲容部众后，奏请在此设县，从龙川、河源划地组成新县，次年筑城。王阳明还建议减轻新县居民的徭役和赋税，使他们能够在战事之后休养。

english:
Hépǔ, on the northern shore of the Gulf of Tonkin, was a port of overseas exchange as early as the Han dynasty. Its coastal waters were famous for natural pearls, the finest in China, which were gathered from oyster beds and sent to markets and imperial courts. From 1368 to the end of the empire it was the seat of Lianzhou Prefecture in Guangdong. The scholar Qu Dajun, writing in the early Qing, counted six pearl pools on the coast from Leizhou and Lianzhou to Annam, and ranked the Duanwang pool highest.

Under the Ming, imperial demand made the pearl fisheries a source of both wealth and hardship. The court repeatedly dispatched officials to supervise the collection, requisitioning boats and labour from the coast. In 1600 the eunuch Lǐ Fèng brought hundreds of vessels and large numbers of men to work the beds, at great expense and with a meagre yield. Local poetry remembered the burdens imposed by such expeditions.
simp_chinese:
合浦位于北部湾北岸，早在汉代便是海外交流的重要港口。沿海盛产天然珍珠，品质为全国最佳，从珠池采得后运往市场和朝廷。自1368年明朝建立到帝制终结，这里一直是广东廉州府的治所。清初学者屈大均记载，雷州、廉州到交趾之间的海岸有六处珠池，以断望池所产为最好。

明代宫廷对珍珠的需求使采珠业带来财富，也带来沉重负担。朝廷屡派官员督采，征调沿海船只与劳力。万历二十八年（1600年），宦官李凤调集数百艘船和大批人手采珠，耗费甚巨，所得却很少。当地诗文留下了对这些征役之苦的记忆。

english: Heqing occupies a highland basin north of Dali, surrounded by mountains and linked to the road toward Lijiang. The Ming established Heqing Prefecture in 1382 and made it a military-civilian prefecture in 1397, organizing local troops under commanders. Its Confucian temple, first founded under the Yuan, was rebuilt in 1632. The town also acquired the Yunhe tower during the Ming, adding a conspicuous landmark to the prefectural seat.
simp_chinese: 鹤庆位于大理以北的高原盆地，群山环绕，道路通向丽江。明朝于1382年设鹤庆府，1397年改为军民府，以军官统领地方兵丁。当地文庙始建于元代，1632年重建；明代兴建的云鹤楼也成为府城醒目的地标。

english: Hequ takes its name from a bend in the Yellow River, which flows beside the western side of the town. Its ferry at Xikou linked the riverbanks and became a busy point for travellers and merchants. A defensive tower by the crossing bears an inscription dating it to 1576. Across the town on East Hill stands the Wenbi Pagoda, built in 1794 with donations from local scholars who hoped to encourage learning and improve the fortunes of their county.
simp_chinese: 河曲因城西黄河转弯而得名。西口渡连接两岸，是行人和商贾往来的渡口；渡口附近的守城楼有碑记载建于1576年。城东山上则有文笔塔，1794年当地士人捐资修建，希望借此振兴文风，兴盛县中文运。

english: Hequ lies in the mountain country of Wuding in northern Yunnan. Before the Yuan conquest it belonged to the Luowu domain; the Yuan renamed the district Hequ and established a prefecture with Yuanmou under its authority. The Ming retained it under Wuding, where hereditary local rulers and imperial officials governed a country of valleys and hills. In the sixteenth century the prefectural seat was moved to the newly built Wuding town, bringing the two administrations together behind the same walls.
simp_chinese: 和曲位于云南北部武定山地。元朝征服之前，这里属于罗婺部；元代改名和曲并设州，辖元谋县。明代沿置，隶属武定，世袭地方统治者与朝廷官员共同治理山谷丘陵间的乡土。十六世纪州治迁入新筑的武定府城，两套行政机构由此同驻一城。

english:
Ancient Aria of the Achaemenids, Herāt commands the fertile valley of the Harī-rūd where the roads from Persia, Khorasan, and India converge.
